name: Amirmahdi Namjoo
lead: I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Maryland. I work on computer architecture and high-performance computing, with recent research on efficient hardware accelerators for sparse computation.
about: I graduated from **Sharif University of Technology** with a B.Sc. in Computer Engineering and am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the **University of Maryland** (since Winter 2023), where I research computer architecture and systems in Bahar Asgari's group. My recent work focuses on hardware acceleration for sparse linear algebra and memory systems. My broader interests span computer security and privacy, high-performance computing, operating systems, and software engineering. During my undergraduate studies I was a teaching assistant for more than fifteen courses and served as president of the Computer Engineering Students' Scientific Chapter.
